Chapter 1202 - 19: Which 2 Peak Heavenly Venerables Are Fighting? (Black Myth Prize List To Be Announced Later)

Chapter 1202: Chapter 19: Which 2 Peak Heavenly Venerables Are Fighting? (Black Myth Prize List to Be Announced Later)

The eyes of the Spirit Prison Venerable contain two deep spirit prisons, which is the Chaos Power path evolved by the Spirit Prison Venerable.

In terms of direct attack, the Spirit Prison Venerable is not particularly strong, but in suppressing and trapping enemies, among the hundreds of Peak Venerables from the six Ancient Countries this time, the Spirit Prison Venerable could definitely rank in the top three.

As long as it’s not a Top Peak Venerable, falling into the spirit prisons of his eyes, one would be trapped for at least several days to several dozen days.

Facing a Top Peak Venerable? Spirit Prison Venerable would not easily bring this level of strong fighters into his gaze.

First, he wouldn’t be able to trap them for long.

Second, it would require most of his focus to suppress them.

Some things are not worth the cost.

This is understandable, after all, among the tens of Peak Venerables from the six Ancient Countries this time, there aren’t many that can truly be called Top Peak Venerables, probably only about twenty or so in total.

The vast majority are still regular Peak Venerables.

Venerable Guanglie can split into thirty-three avatars... Each avatar is equivalent to a relatively strong Peak Venerable and would still be suppressed and trapped for a period when encountering the Spirit Prison Venerable.

In fact, not only would Spirit Prison Venerable not easily make a move against a certain Top Peak Venerable.

Even among the Top Peak Venerables, it’s impossible for them to start a fight upon meeting, not even for the core pillar of a treasure land.

Numerous strong fighters have just entered the treasure land, and there are many unclaimed core pillars. Even if Top Peak Venerables encounter one, one of them would ultimately back away to seek a new core pillar.

As for fighting over it? It’s only when we reach the late stages of contention, when most core pillars have owners, that the Top Peak Venerables would really open up and decide the fate.

"My... eyes?"

The Spirit Prison Venerable let out a scream, his right eye exploded, equivalent to his Chaos Power path being damaged, which greatly affected him.

Clattering sounds.

In the depths of thick temporal fluctuations, Lin Yuan slowly stepped out, glancing at the Spirit Prison Venerable clutching his right eye.

Within the spirit prison of the Spirit Prison Venerable’s right eye, time and space were almost materialized. The moment Lin Yuan was deeply trapped, he deliberately unfolded the Divine Ability ’World’, inside him thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three Seeds of the Fierce Sun formed a great cycle, reflecting to the outer universe, transforming into thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three rounds of fierce suns.

In a single action, he blew out the spirit prison of the Spirit Prison Venerable’s right eye.

"This Spirit Prison Venerable truly lives up to his name." Lin Yuan thought inwardly.

If the Seeds of the Fierce Sun inside him hadn’t formed a great cycle, then falling into the other’s spirit prison, he would have at least been suppressed for several to ten days.

"Galaxy Venerate, do you possess the strength of a Top Peak Venerable?"

The Spirit Prison Venerable’s figure slightly trembled, quickly calming down.

The right eye was blown out, but he still had the left eye, the foundation was still there, and he quickly stabilized.

To be able to break the spirit prison in his eye so forcefully, only a Top Peak Venerable could be capable.

And one who is skilled in killing within the Top Peak Venerables.

The Spirit Prison Venerable was unwilling to bring the Top Peak Venerables into his gaze, due to this very concern.

The Chaos evolution path of Top Peak Venerables encompasses all, and if running into one with stunning killing power, it is entirely possible to crush the spirit prison from within.

At this moment, Lin Yuan was just that.

The expressions of other Peak Venerables from the Da Ling Ancient Country nearby slightly changed.

Top Peak Venerable?

Galaxy Venerate just stepped into the Heavenly Venerable Realm?

"I concede." Lin Yuan quietly watched the Spirit Prison Venerable.

Trapped in the spirit prison of the other’s right eye, Lin Yuan had no choice but to give his all, otherwise being trapped inside would definitely cause greater loss.

"Even if you entered the Heavenly Venerable Realm through the bloodline of the ancestor, I don’t believe your strength increased this rapidly."

Spirit Prison Venerable stared at Lin Yuan, a hidden whirlpool rotating deep in his left eye.

For a moment, the rules of heaven and earth were changing, an abyssal prison took shape, as if the spirit prison in Spirit Prison Venerable’s left eye was transferring outwards.

Facing different levels of enemies, Spirit Prison Venerable had varying methods, against regular Peak Venerables? Simply trap them in the spirit prison of his eyes.

But facing the same level Top Peak Venerables, the approach must be more cautious, first probing with the spirit prison in his eyes, ensuring the opponent has no means to destroy the foundation of the spirit prison before considering trapping them.

"It seems he thinks I used external forces?"

Lin Yuan understood in his heart, the means he used to burst the spirit prison were clearly at the level of Top Peak Venerables, but this doesn’t mean Lin Yuan is a Top Peak Venerable.

Perhaps he used some external techniques?

The right eye was burst, Spirit Prison Venerable suffered heavy losses, he certainly wouldn’t easily let Lin Yuan go.

"Alright then, let me see the strength of a Top Peak Venerable."

Lin Yuan observed the changing heavens and earth around him, a Top Peak Venerable, even in the Chaos Void, they’d be close to an Invincible Great Saint, such an opponent, Lin Yuan found somewhat intriguing.

Previously bursting the spirit prison was entirely due to the Spirit Prison Venerable’s complacency, and Lin Yuan had exploited it to his advantage.

Rumble.

The next moment.

Two starkly different times and spaces began fiercely colliding, the spirit prison of Spirit Prison Venerable’s left eye and Lin Yuan’s external cosmic power continuously interwoven, the terrifying power caused time and space to be annihilated in large areas.

"Spirit Prison has gotten truly angry."

In the distance, Da Ling Peak Venerables who were about to refine the core pillar immediately retreated far away.

The Heavenly Venerables of the six Ancient Countries are divided into four levels.

From weak to strong, they are——

Ordinary Venerables.

Peak Venerables.

Top Peak Venerables.

And Fu Xu Venerable such as the Strongest Peak Venerable.

The Chaos Power paths evolved by Top Peak Venerables are far superior to ordinary Venerables and Peak Venerables, resulting in significant differences in combat power.

As for Fu Xu Venerable like the Strongest Venerable? Actually, they aren’t fundamentally different from Top Peak Venerables, as their Chaos Power paths are essentially on the same level.
